correctness.rationale: Dietzel–Menchón–Vendramin Thm. 5.9 uses the coordinatewise ordered direct sum of integer chains; sign reversal and deletion of inactive coordinates give the asserted finite downsets, including the singleton. A coordinate h of a homomorphism satisfies h(0)=0, and for distinct active indices e_i•e_j=e_j makes h(e_i) and h(e_j) unable to be simultaneously positive. If a_i>0, the two ordered differences between a and a-e_i force h(a)-h(a-e_i)=h(e_i), so telescoping proves the normal form. Each such coordinate map preserves the operation, is monotone, and lands in the target exactly when all maximal source images do. For a full box target the choices are independent, with floor(t_j/r_i) nonzero scales for source i; active unit vectors distinguish the choices. For equal positive side length r, all nonzero scales equal 1. Writing coordinate-copy maps by a pointed function τ gives reversed composition; bijections are exactly coordinate permutations. With k nonzero selected inputs, independent values give image cardinality (r+1)^k. Pointed fibers partition m+1 labels into k+1 blocks with the zero block distinguished. Choosing k nonzero input labels and assigning them to the other blocks gives the stated unrestricted count. An idempotent fixes exactly its used indices, hence choose k fixed nonzero labels and map each remaining index to one of those or zero. Its embedded image sees only the partition: the zero block is forced to zero and other blocks have independent values. Every partition arises by choosing a fixed representative per nonzero block; distinct partitions give distinct sets since r≥1. The three formulas reproduce 64, 23 and 15 at m=3.
residual_risks: The representation is by a direct sum of ordered integer chains, not a claim that the ambient group is free on m generators in the category of lattice-ordered groups. The concrete representation and proofs use the correct coordinatewise order.
Counts for a non-box target require the joint maximal-vector test.

evidence: Prop. 2.4: every L-algebra morphism is monotone and preserves any defined partial product. §3 states the inclusion of self-similar algebras has a left adjoint and that the unit components are inclusions. Thm. 3.3: A is the self-similar closure of a subalgebra X iff X generates the monoid A.
An additive map N^m→N^s has a nonnegative integer matrix. Applying positive difference to two distinct basis vectors shows that a row has at most one nonzero entry.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The normal form is a direct coordinate specialization of the existing considerably more general morphism machinery. In fact Prop. 2.4 alone gives additivity along any path in the downset: the partial product of a-e_i and e_i is defined there and equals a. Passage to the full cone is not needed for that deduction.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The sign-reversed cone is the additive monoid N^m with positive difference. Each downset contains its active standard basis and generates that cone, so its self-similar closure is the full cone by Thm. 3.3. Reflector naturality identifies a diagram homomorphism with an extended cone morphism whose restriction lands in the target.

originality.rationale: There is affirmative broader coverage: Rump's The Category of L-Algebras (2023), Prop. 2.4 and §3 before Thm. 3.3, give preservation of partial multiplication and the self-similar reflector; Thm. 3.3 identifies its value on a monoid-generating subalgebra. Specializing to the Dietzel–Menchón–Vendramin diagrams makes every map a restriction of a cone morphism preserving additive monoid multiplication. The one-sparse coordinate rows are then forced by a relation on pairs of basis vectors. The remaining assertions are the coordinatewise admissibility test and ordinary pointed-function/fiber counts under that specialization. This is direct implication, not an inference from a similar title, and does not depend on access to Rump's earlier 2008 paper.
residual_risks: The 2008 full text was not read; it could contain even more direct antecedents. The failure rests on established 2023 prior implication, not on that uncertainty.
No assertion that the exact displayed formulas previously appeared verbatim.

value.rationale: The explicit coordinate description can be useful exposition. As an independent finding, however, after applying the known theorem on L-algebra morphisms to the known representation, the additional checks and formulas are separate coordinate bounds and standard pointed-set partition counts. The record identifies no nonroutine restriction, counting problem for nonrectangular targets, or additional structural inference that would give the remaining exact counts independent research value.
residual_risks: This is not a claim that concrete descriptions of these hom-sets lack pedagogical or computational convenience.
